data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 and SRC_005 share mechanism: both attempt to resolve the CRT system by pattern detection rather than algebraic inversion, but at different levels of rigor. SRC_005 verifies by exhaustive enumeration of the true x≡3 mod 5 class, while SRC_001 applies a heuristic shortcut (unified -2 offset) without verifying against the second congruence. The shared mechanism is candidate-generation-from-residue-pattern, but SRC_005 adds the falsification step (checking each candidate mod 7) that SRC_001 omits. This omitted verification is the causal reason SRC_001 fails while SRC_005 succeeds. REFUTED IF: SRC_001 actually checks 33 mod 7 and finds it equals 5 (it does not—it claims 33 is a valid solution), or if SRC_005's enumeration does not cover all candidates below 18 (it does: {3,8,13} is exhaustive for x≡3 mod 5, x<18).
